family_reports.body: Two years without your children is a lot of time. Missing teeth and first days. It’s not just hard on us. They’re home now, But we’re all so, so very mentally and emotionally fucked, each in our own ways, and I’m scared we won’t ever be the same.

public_comments.comment_text: THIS bitch. I was grasping at straws, and this therapist said she had time to meet with us. She said she’d love to help, and seemed like she would, told us we had nothing to worry about, and how sorry she was we were having to go through this. Saw her once, and then she went to court and said how she’s siding with the gal or whatever and the attorney and I were BLINDSIDED like what tf just happened
